summary: @nebula.js/sn-line-chart preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated math_init.js
details: Package @nebula.js/sn-line-chart@2.7.1 declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases for the host platform, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js` (falling back to a system `bun` if present). `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line, string-array-rotated obfuscated bundle (opening marker `// @bun @bun-cjs`, `WV8StW` rotator function, large mixed number/string constant table; sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc) whose name is unrelated to the package's declared purpose as a Qlik line-chart supernova. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: installing a second language runtime at preinstall specifically to execute an opaque, heavily obfuscated bundle bypasses tooling that only audits Node-resolved code, and the payload contents are not human-inspectable without deobfuscation. A charting supernova has no legitimate need to fetch a separate runtime and hand it an obfuscated 727 KB blob at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
